notes.title: Boston FIG Award -> Got!
notes.notes:
This week we received our award for best Worldbuilding and Narrative that we won last October when presenting Hiboka to the BostonFIG 
It looks so beautiful and dramatic in sunlight 🤩✨✨✨

We were so happy to show off Hiboka to the public and we'll do more of that in 2023! 💜
